LanguageData.MM_PrintDisruptor.label: Build: Disruptor
LanguageData.MM_PrintDisruptor.description: Build a Disruptor at a construct formator linked to a mechanitor. A colonist pilots it to attack groups of enemies with a homing orb. Requires 5 available bandwidth and binds to the formator’s mechanitor. Boarding a pilot disconnects it and releases bandwidth.
